prayer.title: 11th Prayer, to the Most Holy Theotokos. — Morning Prayers (1982)

blocks.text: 11th Prayer, to the Most Holy Theotokos.

O Most Holy Theotokos, my Lady: through your holy and all-powerful prayers, turn away from me, your humble and unworthy servant, despair, forgetfulness, unreasonableness, indifference, and all unclean, evil and blasphemous thoughts from my wretched heart and darkened mind. Extinguish the flame of my passions, for I am poor and wretched. Deliver me from my numerous and wicked memories and fantasies. Free me from all evil acts, for you are blessed by all generations, and your most honorable name is glorified unto ages of ages. Amen.

The introduction identifies its Psalms as RSV-based; those Psalm passages are excluded here. Morning Prayers and Compline are not presented as complete native rules because their Psalm passages were not reproduced. The full 1982 wording and sequence of included prayer units is retained, including historical OCA jurisdictional titles, source rubrics, and liturgical alternatives. This is not the 2019 St. Tikhon’s edition or the user’s Mother of God Church rule.
